name: Bulkhead
purpose: Partition concurrency so that saturation or stalls inside one dependency cannot exhaust the resources needed by unrelated dependencies.
api_signature:
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Protocol, Awaitable, Callable, TypeVar, Literal

T = TypeVar('T')
Kind = Literal['semaphore', 'thread_pool']

class Bulkhead(Protocol):
    name: str
    kind: Kind
    max_concurrent_calls: int
    max_wait_duration_ms: int
    async def submit(self, fn: Callable[..., Awaitable[T]], /, *args, **kwargs) -> T: ...
    def available_permits(self) -> int: ...
invariants: The number of in-flight calls per partition MUST NEVER exceed max_concurrent_calls.
A caller that waits longer than max_wait_duration_ms for a permit SHALL receive BulkheadFull and NEVER be admitted.
A rejection by Bulkhead MUST NOT be retried inside the same partition in the same request.
Permits CANNOT be shared across partitions; each partition holds an isolated counter.
The bulkhead SHALL emit a rejection metric labelled with the partition name on every rejection.
extension_contract: Adopters register a partition by name and select a kind adapter (semaphore for async I/O, thread_pool for blocking code); a PartitionRouter hook maps requests to partition names, enabling per-tenant or per-dependency isolation. The permit accounting is sealed.

sources.source: Nygard, Release It! 2nd edition (2018), Pragmatic Bookshelf

sources.locator: core-modules/bulkhead, comparison of SemaphoreBulkhead vs FixedThreadPoolBulkhead

why_essential: A single shared thread pool or connection pool is a ship without watertight compartments; without partitioning, one slow dependency drowns all traffic that shared the pool, violating blast-radius guarantees.
alternatives_considered: Global connection pool: shares resources but allows one slow dependency to exhaust everything.
Process-per-dependency isolation: provides strong isolation yet multiplies operational cost and cold-start overhead.
Cooperative quotas enforced in application code: relies on every call site to behave correctly and NEVER composes.
